master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Crusader Kings III grand-strategy game UI icon, one master asset. Input image 1 is the user's existing Korean National Assembly member badge, an identity reference, not a photo to preserve. Create a NEW beautifully hand-painted CK3-style icon of exactly this badge: compact circular dark burgundy backing with fine antique gold outer rim, raised gold five-petal Korean mugunghwa/hibiscus rosette with simplified carved leaf-and-petal relief, round warm ivory enamel center, the TWO Hangul characters '국회' in dark ink centered horizontally and written correctly and clearly (국 then 회; no other text). Preserve the badge silhouette and recognizable gold-flower / ivory-center design from the reference. Style: the tactile painted metalwork and heraldic UI objects of Crusader Kings III, richly shaded antique gold, restrained aged finish, painterly controlled brushwork, bold readable simplified silhouette suitable for 64-120 pixel use; not a glossy photograph or modern vector logo. Front view, centered, symmetrical, orthographic with subtle relief; one cohesive isolated object with crisp alpha edges. Warm upper-left highlights, darker lower-right bevels, no cast shadow outside the silhouette. Composition square, badge occupies about 85% of the canvas, generous equal transparent margins. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no scenery, no lettering outside the two specified Hangul characters, no red cardinal hat, no crown, no extra symbols, no watermark.
